title: ForgeFitOS EXLIB-2C catalog content authoring record
$comment: FAIL-CLOSED CONTRACT. Blank is never approval; a missing review is not approval; unsupported vocabulary fails validation; tracking_mode weight_time fails while unsupported unless deferred=true (deferred entries are excluded from every import subset); external-source fields cannot masquerade as ForgeFitOS-original content; original instructional prose cannot contain copied-source attribution; no record may set import_eligible=true during this milestone. Rules draft-07 cannot express alone are pinned as MANDATORY deterministic validator rules in x_mandatory_validator_rules — they are binding contract, not commentary. Specialist/legal/medical approval is never implied by any default. Publication state (draft/published/retired) is a DATABASE-side lifecycle on exercise_catalog_content, promoted atomically and only for approved/revised versions; authoring records NEVER carry publication state and nothing in an authoring file can publish content.

proposed_canonical_name.$comment: Canonical naming: sentence case, ASCII, no trailing space; uniqueness is enforced by normalized (lower/trim) comparison at validation time, mirroring exercises_user_name_unique_idx and the catalog claim machinery.

aliases.$comment: Search synonyms delivered through the EXISTING alias machinery only; normalized-name collision, normalized uniqueness, and self-reference rules are mandatory deterministic validator rules.

tracking_mode.$comment: weight_time is schema-listed ONLY so deferred entries can declare their future mode; any record with tracking_mode=weight_time MUST have deferred=true and can never be import-eligible until weight_time ships.

movement_pattern.$comment: Includes honest non-strength patterns (cyclic_cardio, locomotion, jump, ground_to_standing, mobility_flow, static_stretch, spinal_articulation) so cardio/gait/jumping/get-up/mobility work is never force-fitted into a strength value.

provenance.$comment: METADATA provenance (maps to exercise_catalog.provenance). forgefitos_original: independently authored for ForgeFitOS; source fields FORBIDDEN. external_source_derived: legacy path only, requires source_url/source_page/retrieved_at and remains subject to the L1/L2 gates.

authored_by.$comment: Prose authorship for THIS content version (maps to exercise_catalog_content.authored_by, NOT to the catalog metadata snapshot); whitespace-only fails.

authored_at.$comment: Maps to exercise_catalog_content.authored_at for this content version.

safety_guidance.$comment: Technique-framed caution only; never medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment claims.

substitutions.$comment: AUTHORING-TIME STAGING INPUT ONLY: canonical-name references resolved fail-closed into exercise_catalog_relationships (logical-id keyed) at load; never persisted as content JSONB. Normalized uniqueness, self-reference rejection, and target resolution are mandatory deterministic validator rules (see x_mandatory_validator_rules).

regressions.$comment: AUTHORING-TIME STAGING INPUT ONLY: canonical-name references resolved fail-closed into exercise_catalog_relationships (logical-id keyed) at load; never persisted as content JSONB. Normalized uniqueness, self-reference rejection, and target resolution are mandatory deterministic validator rules (see x_mandatory_validator_rules).

progressions.$comment: AUTHORING-TIME STAGING INPUT ONLY: canonical-name references resolved fail-closed into exercise_catalog_relationships (logical-id keyed) at load; never persisted as content JSONB. Normalized uniqueness, self-reference rejection, and target resolution are mandatory deterministic validator rules (see x_mandatory_validator_rules).

content_review.$comment: Structurally bound to THIS content version: it maps 1:1 onto exercise_catalog_content.content_status/reviewed_by/reviewed_at/review_rationale and mirrors that table's fail-closed review-audit CHECK. A pending version carries NO review evidence; a decided version carries ALL of it. Blank or missing NEVER reads as approval, and only an approved/revised active content version may ever be delivered or exposed as reviewed content.

review_status.$comment: Authoring-pipeline status; distinct from content_review.status and from any import approval.

import_eligible.$comment: Locked false for the entire authoring milestone; flipping to true is a later, separately approved EXLIB-2F act on an exact fingerprinted payload.

x_mandatory_validator_rules: R1: canonical-name and alias uniqueness is NORMALIZED (lowercased, trimmed) across the whole corpus plus the live seed names; draft-07 uniqueItems is byte-level only, so the deterministic validator MUST fail any normalized duplicate.
R2: no alias may equal its own record's normalized canonical name, and no substitution/regression/progression may reference its own record (self-reference), directly or after normalization.

R3: every substitutions/regressions/progressions entry MUST resolve to an existing corpus canonical name; unresolved targets fail the batch (staging arrays resolve into exercise_catalog_relationships and are never persisted as content JSONB).
R4: blank or whitespace-only strings fail everywhere; the schema's pattern \S enforces most cases, and the validator MUST additionally reject values that are non-blank only by padding after trim.
R5: any record whose tracking_mode is weight_time MUST be excluded from every proposed import subset until the weight_time implementation ships, regardless of other fields.
R6: no record in any EXLIB-2C authoring batch may carry import_eligible true; the validator hard-fails the batch if the key is not literal false.

R7: original instructional prose (setup_steps, execution_steps, breathing_cue, common_mistakes, safety_guidance, equipment_setup) MUST NOT contain copied-source attribution or source-crediting text; the validator scans for attribution markers and fails closed on hits pending human review.
R8: provenance cross-check — a forgefitos_original record carrying any source field, or an external_source_derived record missing one, fails even if a permissive parser accepted it.
